responsibility: Defines the small public interface to the Local Register Allocator for the rest of GCC. It exposes whether simple mode is in use, provides access to a pseudo’s allocno class, and declares the top-level lra driver, elimination helper, and one-time initialization/finalization hooks. Unlike lra-int.h, it is the external header used by non-LRA code to invoke or query LRA behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the small external header for LRA, declaring the top-level entry points and lightweight queries such as allocno class access. The same-stem source gcc/lra.cc contains the actual allocator driver, iteration logic, and internal utility implementation.
